BiblicalUsage: Pistikos means genuine, unadulterated — the pure stuff. Both times it describes the spikenard Mary poured on Jesus in John 12:3, and the woman in Mark 14:3: ointment of spikenard, very costly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe nothing but the genuine will do for Jesus — and Mary gave Him the best she had.
